  induction fuel generalizing start with

      · intro _ i hlo hhi
        omega
      · intro _
        rfl

  intro n α test
  have aux : ∀ (fuel start : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (a : α),
      (M8.FiniteSearch.walk test start fuel).1 = some (i, a) →
      start ≤ i.val ∧ (M8.FiniteSearch.walk test start fuel).2 = i.val - start + 1 := by

    induction fuel with
    | zero =>
        intro start i a hs
